disclaimer: Reminder reference only — NOT legal authority. Season dates, zones, limits, and closures are set annually and can change. Always verify current regulations with the Utah Division of Wildlife Resources before hunting or trapping.

license_summary.furbearer_license: A Utah furbearer license is required to hunt or trap furbearers. A bobcat/marten permit is additionally required for those species. Consult the DWR guidebook for fees, deadlines, and trap-check requirements.
license_summary.method_note: Consult the DWR guidebook for lawful trap types, restrictions, and river-otter-protection device rules — not modeled here beyond the warnings below.

species.notes: Protected from harvest by the Utah legislature since 1899 — there has been no legal harvest of river otters in Utah. The guidebook's trap-device restrictions on the Colorado, Escalante, Green, and Provo rivers are otter-protection rules, not an open season. Included so the app flags any logged take.

species.notes: Wolves may not be hunted or trapped in Utah; any accidental capture or kill must be reported to the DWR immediately. Included so the app flags any logged take.

verification.confirmation_notes: 2026–27 Utah Furbearer (Black Bear & Cougar) Guidebook season tables verified 2026-09-18. River otter closed status confirmed from the official DWR otter page (protected from harvest since 1899; no legal harvest since). Wolf no-take rule confirmed in the guidebook. All season dates, the bobcat permit quota (1 per permit, max 6), marten county restriction, spotted skunk 48-hour reporting rule, and year-round open species read directly from the guidebook.
known_gaps: Scientific names are standard taxonomy, NOT stated in the DWR guidebook — all flagged scientific_name_verified=false; weasel is null because the guidebook does not distinguish species.

Beaver and mink geographic closures, river-otter-protection device restrictions (Colorado, Escalante, Green, Provo rivers), and WMA muskrat permit areas are modeled descriptively — the app cannot resolve exact boundaries.
Detailed lawful-method and trap-check rules are not modeled — users must consult the guidebook.
